pageTitle: Private by default. Built for teams.
heroLedePart1: {{localLabel}} and {{byokLabel}} run entirely on your device: any open model, or your own OpenAI-compatible API keys, with zero data leaving your laptop. Free forever, no seat and no card required.
heroLedePart2: When your team's data is shareable and you want frontier-model intelligence for everyone, AGI Cloud Team and Enterprise plans give every seat managed access with centralized billing and governance. Managed cloud is already open in public alpha today, not invite-only.
wedgeHeading: Private by default, on your terms.
wedgeLede: Local and BYOK are how individual engineers and IT-cautious companies get started with AGI: nothing leaves the device unless you choose to send it.
localTierBody: Run Ollama or LM Studio offline on your laptop. No keys, no quotas, no internet required.
byokTierBody: Bring your own keys to 10+ supported providers, including your own OpenAI-compatible custom endpoints. Provider billing and data handling stay with your account.
byokFeature3: Visible provider label on every route
teamLede: This is what AGI is built to sell: shared, governed access to frontier models for the whole org, with the local wedge already proven by your engineers.
teamTierBody: Pooled managed-cloud capacity across your team, sized to how your team actually works. Talk to us and we will size the plan with you.
teamFeature1: Shared managed-cloud capacity pool across every seat
teamFeature2: Centralized billing, one invoice for the whole team
teamFeature3: Every seat includes Local, BYOK, and managed cloud access
teamFeature4: Admin and seat management, rolling out in public alpha
enterpriseBody: Discuss SSO/SCIM roadmap, audit needs, data retention, and a rollout scoped to how your org actually works. Reach out and we will plan it together.
enterpriseFeature3: SSO, audit, and data retention (roadmap, scoped with your team)
enterpriseFeature4: Annual contract with a dedicated account manager
individualHeading: Prefer to go solo? Cloud works there too.
individualLede: The same managed cloud that powers Team and Enterprise is available on its own, with plans that scale from a light daily trial up to heavy individual workloads.
freeTierBody: A small free daily allowance to try AGI Cloud with frontier models, no credit card required.
freeFeature1: Frontier model access to try AGI Cloud
freeFeature3: Upgrade anytime as you need more
basicTierBody: More daily cloud usage than Free, for individuals doing regular light work in the browser.
basicFeature1: More daily cloud usage than Free
proTierBody: Generous monthly cloud usage for professionals and power users doing daily work.
proFeature1: Generous monthly cloud usage for daily work
maxTierBody: The highest individual usage tier, for intensive daily multi-agent workloads.
waitlistHeading: Get early access to Team and Enterprise
waitlistBody: Managed cloud is already open in public alpha, sign in and start with Free. Leave your details for early access to Team seats, Enterprise controls, and higher-capacity plans as usage ledgering, admin tooling, and provider-cost controls roll out.
compareSubheading: Local and BYOK run on Desktop and CLI. Free, Pro, and Max are the individual cloud on-ramp. Team and Enterprise are built for shared, governed access.
compareLocalBestFor: Offline, privacy-first individuals and IT-cautious companies
compareByokBestFor: Power users and companies who want zero markup
compareFreeBestFor: Trying AGI Cloud before you commit
compareBasicBestFor: Individuals doing regular light daily work
compareTeamUsage: Shared capacity pool, sized to your team
compareTeamBestFor: Teams needing shared frontier access with governance
compareEnterpriseUsage: Dedicated capacity, scoped to your org
